name: Ahmad Shah Qajar
contribution: The Shah of Iran from 16 July 1909 to 15 December 1925, and the seventh and final ruling member of the Qajar dynasty.

checks.lead: Ahmad Shah Qajar (Persian: احمد شاه قاجار‎; 21 January 1898 – 21 February 1930) was the Shah of Iran (Persia) from 16 July 1909 to 15 December 1925, and the seventh and final ruling member of the Qajar dynasty.
